card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: Mostly the first digit of a two-digit number in dosing or schedule text, such as the 5 in 50% or the 2 in 21 days. Also fires on a few small words like for, the and a in web text.

modes.label: Leading digit
modes.description: A digit that starts a longer number, with the next digit still to come.
modes.example: Resume Unituxin infusion at <<5>>0% of the previous rate.

modes.label: Small words in web text
modes.description: Short words such as the, a or for in general web text.
modes.example: Lisa Montgomery embraces her nephew Thursday after<< a>> tornado tore apart her home in Cleburn

card.writes: It suppresses digits and small words as the next piece, and promotes odd name fragments, so it likely signals that the number or word is not finished.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number like 50 or 21, when more digits are about to follow.
